messages:
nidhi: heads up: production webpack build started throwing "Unexpected token export" when our sdk package uses conditional exports + sideEffects:false. dev mode is fine.

jon: can you share a tiny package.json?

nidhi: snippet: { "exports": { "./*": { "import":"./esm/$1.js", "require":"./cjs/$1.js" } }, "types":"dist/types/index.d.ts" }

sam: repro: build lib -> consumer-webpack (mode=production) -> serve static -> runtime fails. Seems webpack picks import entry for subpath in prod.

jon: workaround that worked locally: add a distinct "node" condition in exports pointing to cjs and ensure webpack resolve.mainFields includes ['exports','module','main'].

ci-bot: CI job 78 failed: consumer-webpack production build -> Unexpected token export (node 18).

nidhi: plan: add tiny repro in repo, doc recommended resolve settings for webpack/vite/rollup, and add CI consumer-build matrix. filing task.
